description: E001 has documented occurrence, date, Vouvouni location and a “hundreds” estimate. Both reports say participants sought justice for Ayman. The Gazette context says he had been arrested and held at a military barracks, had apparent physical-abuse injuries, was returned by gendarmes, and an inquiry was opened, but the protest story does not explicitly quote a request to a government institution or specify official action. The demanded domestic-state target remains unresolved.
required_followup: Find a distinct contemporaneous account or direct statement that specifies whether participants demanded investigation/prosecution or other action by Comorian state authorities; otherwise retain pending_state_target.

type: bounded source, region, sector and language coverage
description: Captured French and English general searches and all four March date windows. Local follow-ups covered Ayman/Vouvouni, pension continuity, islands (Ngazidja, Anjouan, Mohéli) and education, transport, health and strikes. Arabic search returned date-noisy unrelated material; no feasible indexed Shikomori query was identified. Search results were heavily contaminated by France, Mayotte, out-of-month items and older stories. Local public searches did not reproduce the codebook’s Lexis-Nexis method or systematically examine all island radio/print archives.
required_followup: A material remaining step is targeted reporting for E001 state-demand specificity and E002 turnout/site; for broad coverage, consult native Shikomori/Arabic or island archives only if a concrete index/source can be located. No absence/exhaustiveness conclusion.
